records.name: m0-calc
records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one small premium 3D course-material icon for a website row, matching an existing family of glossy dark graphite-metal chatbot head, browser-window and fountain-pen icons with vivid hot-pink edges. Create a SINGLE isolated compact centered object on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background with alpha, square 1024x1024 canvas. Three-quarter product view, bold simple readable silhouette suitable at 120px, main object occupies about 75% of canvas with 12% clear safety margin on all sides. Materials: gunmetal / dark charcoal / black glossy metal faces, beveled edges, occasional mid-gray metal highlights, vivid pink #FF2585 edge lighting and restrained soft pink glow close to the object. All paper-like surfaces must be DARK graphite, never white or cream. No background color, no room, no floor, no ground plane, no platform, no vignette, no large shadow rectangle, no light plane, no backdrop. No flat emoji or flat vector illustration. No words, no letters, no numerals, no watermark, no logo, no random glyphs. Only simple meaningful pictograms and short unlabeled lines are allowed on the object. Do not put a title or caption in the image. One material only; no unrelated props, no collage. A single chunky dark graphite handheld calculator, blank reflective display, a clear grid of rounded blank keys with just one vivid pink key. On one corner a tiny integrated target pictogram embossed in pink communicates personal-goal calculation. Keep this unmistakably a calculator, not a phone. No currency signs or numeric amounts.
